root_cause: connection pool leak in checkout-service: connections acquired on the request path are never returned, so the pool saturates and every later request waits for one

evidence.observation: rose from 0.0 to 0.652, flat at zero through the baseline
evidence.supports: the pool is exhausted, not merely busy

evidence.observation: 10 leak events, none in the baseline
evidence.supports: connections are acquired and not returned - the leak itself

evidence.observation: 656 timeout events, none in the baseline
evidence.supports: requests fail waiting for a connection, downstream of the exhaustion
the connection acquisitions that never completed
the user-visible impact follows the pool saturation

ruled_out: bad release (v2.8 deployment) - no deployment event appears, and db_pool_timeout and connection_leaked both carry version=v2.7
inventory-service internal error - dependency_error is only x7 with status=409 while db_pool_usage reached 0.652; that pattern leaves db_pool_usage near 0.1
memory leak - memory_mb went 89.3 to 92.1 and cache_entries stayed at 0, both among the metrics that stayed normal
